notes.detail: Clean shell: headstones (mixed stairs and wall posts), two spruce benches, stone cross on a plinth; no lanterns, pots or plants yet, so it reads a little bare.
notes.depth: Full-block stone brick piers stand proud of the thin low cobblestone wall and throw shadows; the cross plinth and benches add relief.
notes.roof: No roof (yard): judged on the walls and gate. Walls have no coping and the gate is just two 2-high piers with nothing over them.
notes.shape: Plain rectangle with a symmetric cross-shaped gravel path; the empty back-left plot (kept for the L2 yew) gives a little asymmetry.
notes.life: Only the gravel paths; no plants yet.
notes.scale: 9 x 12 yard: right for a village churchyard.
notes.grandeur: Modest; fine for a first build.

visual.summary: Walled churchyard shell: low cobblestone wall with stone brick piers, cross-shaped gravel paths, six graves with headstones, two benches and a stone cross at the back. groundLayer 0 (flush with the grass), which the mod does not support yet.
problems: Reachability: 80 of 86 standing places reached, all paths and graves walkable; the 6 unreached are pier and cross-arm tops, fine.
Note: meta.groundLayer 0 (flush piece), not supported by the mod yet.
